tech_stack: C# .NET 6+, PostgreSQL (Dapper/Npgsql), Redis (ISeismicRedisCache), Kafka (Confluent Avro), Azure Blob Storage

owns: Channel posts, comments, and emoji reactions
depends_on: UMS — user profile, group membership, user deactivation events
BSS — blob storage temporary URL generation
Social Sharing Service — social network stream sync and share execution
Entitlement Service — user roles per tenant
Notification Service — outbound push notification delivery
http_deps: UMS — user profile, groups, group IDs, group membership
BSS — temporary image URL and file download URL
Social Sharing Service — stream create/update sync and share dispatch
ProofPoint Native — native compliance API variant
Entitlement Service — user roles per tenant
CMS3 — channel, post, and content read/write
background_services: UMSEventConsumer — Kafka: handles user deactivation/deletion, updates compliance state
NotificationEventConsumer — internal in-memory queue: dispatches notifications to Notification Service via HTTP
ContentVFSProcessedEventConsumer — Kafka: handles video processing completion events from VFS
ContentUpdatedEventConsumer — Kafka: handles CMS content-ingested events (ContentIngestedEvent)

domains.name: Channel
domains.responsibility: Manages community channels including creation, membership permissions, join/leave/request flows, and Redis-cached user channel views.
domains.health_reason: Cache management (Redis key enumeration, TTL-based reload) is embedded directly in ChannelAppService alongside domain logic, creating infrastructure coupling. Permission mutation is orchestrated in the AppService rather than encapsulated in ChannelEntity.
key_operations: ChannelController: CreateChannel, UpdateChannel, UpdateChannelPermission, UpdateChannelVisit, GetUserChannelDetail, GetChannels, DeleteChannel, JoinChannel, LeaveChannel, AddRequest, Approve, Deny, ChannelsByFilterId, GetChannelsByMembership
ChannelAppService: CreateChannelAsync, UpdateChannelPermissionAsync, JoinChannelAsync, LeaveChannelAsync, AddRequestAsync, ApproveAsync, DenyAsync, ReloadAllUserChannelsCache, GetUserChannelsAsync

invariants: Only user with seismic.channels.manage permission can create a channel
Only channel member with MANAGE access can update channel metadata or permissions
ChannelType must be one of PUBLIC, AUTHORIZEDONLY, PRIVATE
Only the channel owner can delete the channel
A user cannot join a channel they are already a member of
Bulk access type update may not set MANAGE

domains.name: Post
domains.responsibility: Manages short-form posts within community channels, including reactions, featuring/unfeaturing, draft management, and per-channel permission enforcement.
domains.health_reason: PostAppService contains presentation-layer helpers (GetPostAuthor, GetContinuationToken, GetContinuationParam, GetUsersAsync) that are public-API concerns, not domain logic. Channel lastPostTime reversion after post deletion is a direct cross-domain call rather than a domain event.
key_operations: PostController: CreateOrUpdatePost, DeletePost, GetPostDetail, GetChannelPosts, GetPosts, AddReaction, RemoveReaction, GetPostReactions, FeaturePost, UnFeaturePost, GetFeaturePosts, PostsByFilterId, GetDraftPosts

PostAppService: CreatePostAsync, UpdatePostAsync, DeletePostAsync, GetPostDetailAsync, GetChannelPostsAsync, AddReactionAsync, RemoveReactionAsync, FeaturePostAsync, UnFeaturePostAsync, GetDraftPostsAsync

invariants: Only the post creator can update a post
User must have POST access to the channel to create a post
Only channel MANAGE member or post creator can delete a post
A user may have at most one draft post at a time
Featured post limit is 4 concurrently overlapping items per channel per time window

domains.name: Comment
domains.responsibility: Manages threaded comments and emoji reactions on posts, including reply-count tracking, mention expansion, and notification dispatch.
domains.health_reason: UpdateSubCommentTrackByCommentAsync is a multi-step orchestration (fetch top-reacted, most-recent, oldest comments, update post fields) embedded in CommentAppService that belongs in a domain event handler. Cross-domain post mutation is performed directly rather than via events.
key_operations: CommentController: CreateOrUpdateComment, DeleteComment, GetCommentDetail, GetComments, AddCommentReaction, DeleteReaction, GetCommentReactions
CommentAppService: CreateCommentAsync, UpdateCommentAsync, DeleteCommentAsync, AddReactionAsync, RemoveReactionAsync, GetReactionsByCommentIdAsync, GetCommentsAsync

invariants: Only the comment creator can update or delete their comment
A deleted comment retains its record with Status=Deleted
Reply count must reflect only non-deleted child comments
Mention expansion resolves group IDs to individual user IDs

domains.name: Announcement
domains.responsibility: Manages tenant-wide or channel-targeted announcements with Unpublished/Published/Scheduled lifecycle, featured pinning with overlap limits, and notification dispatch.
domains.health_reason: Publish-status transition side-effects (updating and reverting channel lastPostTime across 9 state-transition cases) are implemented as multi-branch if/else in AnnouncementAppService rather than a state machine in AnnouncementEntity. Cross-domain Channel mutation is a direct service call, not a domain event.
key_operations: AnnouncementController: CreateAnnouncement, UpdateAnnouncementPost, UpdateAnnouncementSetting, GetAnnouncement, GetAnnouncements, DeleteAnnouncement, FeatureAnnouncementPost, UnFeatureAnnouncementPost, GetFeatureAnnouncementPosts

AnnouncementAppService: CreateAnnouncementAsync, UpdateAnnouncementPostAsync, UpdateAnnouncementSettingAsync, DeleteAnnouncementAsync, FeatureAnnouncementPostAsync, UnFeatureAnnouncementPostAsync, GetFeatureAnnouncementsAsync

invariants: Only user with seismic.channels.announcement.manage permission can create, update, or delete announcements
Featured post limit is 4 concurrently overlapping per recipient channel
Notification dispatched only when PublishStatus=Published, NotificationOptions set, and recipients exist
DidNotify flag prevents duplicate notifications

domains.name: Content
domains.responsibility: Manages P2P content attachments (file uploads and external videos) stored in CMS3 and surfaced via a fat-model rendition endpoint for the channel viewer.
domains.health_reason: ContentAppService is a thin pass-through to ContentService with no business rules. The fat-model switch-case (File vs ExternalVideo type dispatch) contains format logic that belongs in domain entity factory methods. No invariants are enforced.
key_operations: ContentController: CreateContent, GetContent, DeleteContent, GetUPFatContent (fat model rendition)

invariants: ContentType must be File or ExternalVideo
Content is owned by its creator

domains.name: Social Stream
domains.responsibility: Manages social media streams (social-sharing channels) with configuration, compliance settings, RSS feeds, interest filters, mandatory flags, and social sharing service synchronization.
domains.health_reason: SocialStreamEntity holds stream configuration and SocialStreamAppService cleanly orchestrates social sharing service notifications on create/update with relevant-change detection. Domain logic is well-scoped.
key_operations: SocialStreamController: CreateSocialStream, UpdateSocialStream, GetSocialStream, GetSocialStreams, DeleteSocialStream, UpdateStreamOrders, BulkImportSocialStreams
SocialStreamAppService: CreateSocialStreamAsync, UpdateSocialStreamAsync, DeleteSocialStreamAsync, UpdateStreamOrdersAsync, BulkImportAsync, GetSocialStreamAsync, GetSocialStreamsAsync

invariants: userId must be non-empty on create
Social Sharing Service must be notified on create and on update of relevant properties
Stream order must be unique within tenant
Mandatory streams cannot be removed by end users

domains.name: Social Content
domains.responsibility: Manages the social content library—individual content items for social sharing—with compliance pre-screening, batch creation, image URL resolution, and fuzzy search.
domains.health_reason: SocialContentAppService directly calls ProofPoint compliance inline after content creation (TryQueueComplianceAsync), coupling Social Content and Social Compliance domains. Compliance queueing should be triggered via a domain event (SocialContentCreated) to decouple the domains.
key_operations: SocialContentController: CreateSocialContent, BatchCreateSocialContent, GetSocialContent, UpdateSocialContent, SearchSocialContent, DeleteSocialContent, GetSocialContentImageUrls
SocialContentAppService: CreateSocialContentAsync, BatchCreateSocialContentAsync, GetSocialContentAsync, UpdateSocialContentAsync, SearchSocialContentAsync, GetSocialContentImageUrlsAsync

invariants: ComplianceStatus must be 'pending' on creation
Content must reference a valid social stream
Images are stored in BSS and referenced by blobId

domains.name: Social Share
domains.responsibility: Manages scheduling, delegation (advisor/delegate mode), compliance validation, and execution of social shares to external social networks via the Social Sharing Service.
domains.health_reason: SocialShareEntity models share state including compliance fields, delegation info, and network destinations. SocialShareAppService correctly encapsulates delegation logic, schedule time resolution, and compliance pre-check before dispatching to the Social Sharing Service provider.
key_operations: SocialShareController: CreateSocialShare, UpdateSocialShare, GetSocialShare, SearchSocialShares, DeleteSocialShare, GetSocialShareImageUrls
SocialShareAppService: CreateSocialShareAsync, UpdateSocialShareAsync, GetSocialShareAsync, DeleteSocialShareAsync, SearchSocialSharesAsync, GetSocialShareImageUrlsAsync

invariants: ScheduledTime must be a valid future or present time
ComplianceStatus must be 'approved' before execution when compliance feature is enabled
Delegation requires valid advisorId and delegate info
Social network destinations must be specified

domains.name: Social Compliance
domains.responsibility: Orchestrates content compliance screening via ProofPoint and ProofPoint Native, tracks per-user compliance status, and resolves violations for social content and social shares.
domains.health_reason: SocialComplianceAppService is entirely procedural—it orchestrates calls to ProofPoint providers and patches entity status fields with no domain invariants encapsulated in UserComplianceDetailsEntity. Compliance rules (exemption via permission, violation thresholds, retry logic) are scattered as inline code in the AppService.

invariants: User with seismic.social.compliance.non-compliant.user permission may bypass compliance checks
Compliance status is derived from ProofPoint API response and cannot be self-asserted by the user

domains.name: AI Generated Post
domains.responsibility: Caches AI-generated social media post drafts keyed by tenantId + contentReferenceId + style, with upsert semantics and batch retrieval with not-found reporting.
domains.health_reason: AIGeneratedPostAppService has clear input validation, upsert logic, and batch retrieval with not-found tracking. The entity is well-defined for its caching role. Status transitions are validated at the AppService boundary.

invariants: ContentReferenceId and Style are required and non-empty
Status must be one of: generated, failed, pending
TenantId is derived from context provider, not caller-supplied

domains.name: Generative AI Settings
domains.responsibility: Manages tenant-level generative AI configuration: enabled flag, style enforcement mode, predefined styles, default style index, and auto-generation flags for curators and publishers.
domains.health_reason: GenerativeAISettingsAppService has clear validation, upsert semantics, and a GetOrCreateDefault fallback that avoids persisting defaults. Entity encapsulates all settings fields and the AppService enforces valid style names and enforcement modes.
key_operations: GenerativeAISettingsAppService: CreateGenerativeAISettingsAsync, UpdateGenerativeAISettingsAsync, GetGenerativeAISettingsAsync, CreateOrUpdateGenerativeAISettingsAsync, GetOrCreateDefaultAsync

invariants: StyleEnforcementMode must be one of: disabled, pre_defined, both, custom_only
Style names within PredefinedStyles must be unique
TenantId is derived from context provider

domains.name: Blob Storage
domains.responsibility: Proxies the Blob Storage Service (BSS) to generate temporary image URLs and file download URLs for channel content attachments.
domains.health_reason: BSSAppService is a pure pass-through to IBSSServiceProvider with no domain logic. BlobStorageController conflates three concerns (raw blobs, social content image URLs, social share image URLs) that belong in their respective domain controllers.

invariants: blobId must be non-empty

domains.name: Feature Management
domains.responsibility: Proxies the Feature Management Service (FMS) to expose tenant feature flag state to channel-service API consumers.
domains.health_reason: FMSAppService and FMSController are pure HTTP proxies with no domain logic. Feature flag evaluation is an infrastructure concern that should be consumed internally at the point of use, not re-exposed as a standalone REST API endpoint.

domains.name: Entitlement
domains.responsibility: Proxies the Entitlement Service to expose user role data for a given tenant to channel-service API consumers.
domains.health_reason: EntitlementAppService and EntitlementController are pure HTTP proxies with no domain logic. User role data should be consumed internally by domain services rather than re-surfaced as a pass-through API endpoint.

domains.name: DAS
domains.responsibility: Proxies the Data Access Service (DAS) to expose social compliance configuration schema data to channel-service API consumers.
domains.health_reason: DASAppService and DASController are pure HTTP proxies. Social compliance configuration belongs within the Social Compliance domain and should be consumed internally, not re-surfaced as a standalone API endpoint.

steps.label: User submits POST /posts via PostController
PostAppService verifies user has POST access to each target channel via UserChannelsService
PostService creates post record in CMS3
ChannelAppService reloads all user channels cache (async fire-and-forget)
NotificationEventDispatcher queues post notification (async)

workflows.name: Publish Announcement with Channel Side Effects

steps.label: Admin creates/updates announcement via AnnouncementController
AnnouncementAppService checks seismic.channels.announcement.manage permission via UserService
AnnouncementService persists announcement in CMS3
AnnouncementAppService directly mutates Channel lastPostTime via IChannelService
NotificationEventDispatcher queues announcement notification (async)
ChannelAppService reloads all user channels cache (async)

workflows.name: Social Content Creation with Inline Compliance Check

steps.label: User creates social content via SocialContentController
SocialContentAppService creates entity with ComplianceStatus=pending
SocialContentService persists content to CMS3
SocialContentAppService directly calls TryQueueComplianceAsync inline (cross-domain coupling)
ProofPoint API scans content for violations
SocialContentService updates ComplianceStatus to approved/rejected
User creates social share via SocialShareController
SocialShareAppService validates compliance status (ProofPoint pre-check)
SocialShareAppService resolves schedule time via ScheduleTimeService
SocialShareService persists share record in CMS3
SocialSharingServiceProvider dispatches share to social network
UMS publishes UserEvent (deactivated/deleted) to Kafka
UMSEventConsumer receives and deserializes Avro UserEvent
Consumer checks social-channels-compliance feature flag via FMS
Consumer updates user compliance status in channel service DB
User requests channel access via POST /channels/{channelId}/requests
ChannelAppService verifies user is not already a member
ChannelService persists access request in CMS3
NotificationEventDispatcher notifies channel MANAGE members (async)
Manager approves/denies via POST /channels/{channelId}/requests/{requestId}/approve
ChannelService adds approved user as member or removes request

gap_analysis.title: Anemic proxy domains surfaced as public API controllers
gap_analysis.detail: FMSController+FMSAppService, DASController+DASAppService, and EntitlementController+EntitlementAppService are pure HTTP pass-through proxies re-exposed as first-class REST endpoints. Feature flags, compliance configuration, and entitlement roles are infrastructure concerns that should be consumed directly by internal domain services, not re-surfaced as API endpoints. This leaks infrastructure topology into the public API contract.

gap_analysis.title: Social compliance check tightly coupled to social content creation
gap_analysis.detail: SocialContentAppService.TryQueueComplianceAsync is called synchronously (inline) immediately after content persistence in CreateSocialContentAsync and BatchCreateSocialContentAsync. This couples the Social Content and Social Compliance domains directly. A SocialContentCreated domain event should trigger compliance checking asynchronously, keeping domains independent and enabling retry/backoff.

gap_analysis.title: AnnouncementAppService directly mutates Channel.lastPostTime
gap_analysis.detail: AnnouncementAppService calls IChannelService.UpdateLastPostTime and IChannelService.RevertLastPostTimeAsync inside UpdateAnnouncementSettingAsync and DeleteAnnouncementAsync. The 9-case publish-status transition matrix driving these calls belongs in the Announcement domain as a state machine, with channel side-effects triggered by domain events (AnnouncementPublished, AnnouncementUnpublished) handled by the Channel domain.

gap_analysis.title: Missing domain events for core state transitions
gap_analysis.detail: No domain events are published for ChannelCreated, PostCreated, AnnouncementPublished, SocialShareScheduled, SocialContentCreated, etc. Notifications, cache reloads, and compliance checks are dispatched via direct synchronous service calls, creating tight cross-domain coupling and making the system fragile to domain boundary changes. Domain events would allow each domain to react independently.

gap_analysis.title: Redis cache management embedded in ChannelAppService
gap_analysis.detail: ChannelAppService contains direct Redis key enumeration (GetKeys pattern scan), TTL configuration, byte-array serialization, and multi-pattern reload logic across ReloadChannelsCache, ReloadKeyPatternCache, ReloadUserChannelsCache, and ReloadAllUserChannelsCache methods. Cache invalidation is an infrastructure concern that should live in a dedicated cache adapter or cache-aside policy, not the application service.

gap_analysis.title: SocialComplianceAppService has no encapsulated domain logic
gap_analysis.detail: SocialComplianceAppService is entirely procedural: it orchestrates calls to IProofPointServiceProvider and IProofPointNativeServiceProvider and patches ComplianceStatus on SocialContentEntity and SocialShareEntity. Compliance rules (who is exempt via seismic.social.compliance.non-compliant.user permission, what violation count is blocking, retry/backoff) are scattered as inline code. These invariants should be expressed as domain rules in UserComplianceDetailsEntity.

gap_analysis.title: BlobStorageController serves three distinct domains
gap_analysis.detail: BlobStorageController mixes blob URL generation for raw CMS blobs (BSS), social content image URLs (SocialContentAppService), and social share image URLs (SocialShareAppService). The social content and social share image URL endpoints belong in SocialContentController and SocialShareController respectively, with BSS as a pure infrastructure adapter called internally.

gap_analysis.title: PostAppService contains public-API presentation logic
gap_analysis.detail: PostAppService includes GetPostAuthor (user display name resolution), GetContinuationToken, GetContinuationParam (base64 pagination token encoding/decoding), and GetUsersAsync—all presentation-layer concerns for the public REST API. These helpers do not belong in the application service and inflate its responsibility beyond domain orchestration.
